Items.Subject: Password expires while I'm on leave
Items.Body: I got the 14-day password expiry reminder but I'll be on parental leave when it lapses. Can I reset it early from my phone without a company laptop, and will that sync everywhere?

Items.Subject: HomeFix-Print queue disappeared
Items.Body: After the last laptop update the HomeFix-Print queue vanished from my printers list, so I can't badge-print anything. How do I get it back without waiting for a technician?

Items.Subject: Old expense report rejected - over 90 days
Items.Body: I found a conference expense from last quarter that never got filed, and Concur rejected my report saying it's too old. Is there any way to still get reimbursed?

Items.Subject: New phone MFA + shared mailbox for team
Items.Body: Two things: I'm switching phones this weekend, what do I need to do so MFA keeps working? And my team just took over the returns@ mailbox, how do the four of us get access without sharing a password?

Items.Subject: Dual-boot Linux on company laptop for data science
Items.Body: Our data science group wants to dual-boot Ubuntu on HomeFix laptops for GPU workloads. Is dual-boot supported, and is there an approved disk-partitioning tool we should use?

Items.Subject: Concur down for all of finance, month-end close TODAY
Items.Body: The entire finance team gets a 502 error opening Concur since 8am. Month-end close is due today at 6pm and nothing can be approved. This is blocking the close, please treat as critical.

Items.Subject: Software request stuck three weeks - unacceptable
Items.Body: My request for the diagram tool has been sitting in approval for three weeks with zero updates. This is unacceptable for a $200 license. If it isn't sorted by Friday I'll buy it on my own card and expense it.
